text.text:
2-minute read

In emergency medical services (EMS), every second counts, and the reliability of your equipment can mean everything. Stryker’s ProCare Services is here to ensure your emergency care tools are always ready to perform, so you can focus on what really matters—saving lives.

Why ProCare is more than medical equipment maintenance

ProCare isn’t just a service plan; it’s a partnership. We’re here to help you keep your equipment in top shape, so you can have peace of mind when it matters most. Here’s what sets ProCare apart:

  • Skilled technicians you can count on
    Our service specialists are experts working on Stryker equipment. They’re highly trained to maintain your tools to the highest standards.

  • Only genuine parts for total reliability
    We use original equipment manufacturer (OEM) parts, designed specifically for your equipment. This means you can trust in the quality and performance every time.

  • Staying ahead with preventive care
    Regular checkups and maintenance catch potential issues early, reducing downtime and keeping your equipment running smoothly for years to come.

Service plans designed with you in mind

We know that every EMS team has different needs, so we offer three flexible ProCare plans to fit your situation:

  1. Preventive Maintenance
    Dedicated Stryker technicians perform regular, on-site maintenance to ensure your equipment is always in top shape.

  2. ProCare Protect
    Unlimited service calls with OEM support give you reliable coverage while helping you manage your budget.

  3. ProCare Prevent
    All the benefits of ProCare Protect, plus a robust preventive maintenance program and compliance documentation to keep you ahead of the game.

What you get with ProCare

  • Focus on patient care
    By taking care of your equipment, ProCare gives you the time and confidence to focus fully on your patients.

  • Long-lasting equipment
    With regular care and genuine parts, your equipment can go the distance.

  • Help with documentation
    We handle all the documentation for maintenance and inspections.

Investing in ProCare means partnering with people who know your equipment inside and out. We’re here to help you deliver exceptional emergency care with tools you can trust every step of the way.

Learn more about how ProCare can support your team by visiting Stryker’s ProCare Services page.
